interpretation_limits: This implements selected binding comparators, not the full paper guard G.
Attribution-policy differences are separate from semantic violations; instance-policy rejections are not automatically false positives.
Typed local moneyDecimal2dp equality is not the paper's original canonical JSON equality.
Verified read hashes and consumes the same bytes in a single-process adapter; distributed transactions are untested.
Defined fixture frequencies do not estimate natural prevalence or independent task success.
x2_score.semantic_truth_source: persisted SQL effects compared directly to pre-execution approved_effect fixtures
x2_score.unit_of_analysis: 9 defined fixtures crossed with 4 bindings (including 1 diagnostic) and 2 executor modes; 72 routes, not independent tasks
